extracted.intended_audience: children's authors, illustrators, publishers, and SCBWI members
extracted.subtask_description: Announcement of the 2026 Golden Kite Awards winners and honors, listing award categories, named awards, prize amounts, and noting the peer-judged nature and submission volume of the competition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judged exclusively by peers
rubrics_metrics.description: Founded in 1973, the Golden Kite Awards stand as the premier children’s literary award judged exclusively by peers, making them truly unique in the world of children’s literature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates that evaluation is performed by fellow authors/illustrators (peers) rather than critics, professional jurors, or public vote; the page does not specify scoring criteria or process beyond 'peer' judging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognition of outstanding achievement
rubrics_metrics.description: The Golden Kite Awards recognize outstanding achievement in seven categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Purpose of the awards is to single out outstanding work within the listed categories; no further definition of 'outstanding' or scoring rubric provided on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission volume / competitiveness
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals high competition and selectivity; no cutoff or submission eligibility details provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category label for evaluating fiction aimed at young reader and middle grade audiences; the page lists winners/honors but does not provide subcriteria for evaluation within this category.

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category label for evaluating fiction aimed at young adult readers; no further evaluative guidance on the page.
